The '''Trick or Treat Bag''' is an {{Uncommon}} backpack item that has 27 slots for [[Candy|Candies]]. It also automatically picks up and stores your candies inside the bag.

It can be upgraded into the {{Item|Spooky Sack}}.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Trick or Treat Bag''' can be purchased from the {{NPCSprite|Fear Mongerer}} during the [[Spooky Festival]].

== Usage ==
'''Trick or Treat Bag''' is mainly used to store large amounts of candy without taking up inventory space.

As a bag, it cannot be put into the player's [[Ender Chest]] or [[Backpack]]s, though it can be put into {{zone|Private Island}} chests or the [[Personal Vault]].

{{Crafting Usage}}

== Trivia ==
*The '''Trick or Treat Bag''' inventory is tied to the player's profile, meaning having multiple of them does not allow the player to store more candy.
